name: Swampy bias breathe
desc: Slow-ish valve-bias tremolo that adds grit at the trough and softens when you dig in

refs.why: the swampy amp vibrato on Fogerty's E7 riff, from his Kustom amp

notes: Bias model: crossover grit near the trough, sag ducks the depth on hard strums; Fogerty calls it vibrato, the Kustom blended both
